reason: The analyst's model leaves out productivity_2020 and the other pre-period controls, even though training correlates with prior productivity (about 0.21). It also trims the outcome's tails and reports only one specification. I reproduced their 0.627 (p=0.0045). Adding the pre-period controls gives 0.58 on the full sample and 0.50 (p=0.024) on the trimmed sample. The positive sign survives, but the reported estimate is inflated by omitted-confounder bias and the specification is not defensible enough to release.
